network_outages.quote: The long term planned outage of the Coffs Harbour to Koolkhan 132kV line was still in effect. To manage this outage, AEMO invoked a constraint to prevent the Armidale to Koolkhan line being overloaded in the event of the failure of the Coffs Harbour to Lismore line. As a result , electricity was forced out of Queensland and into northern New South Wales across the Terranora interconnector by about 130 MW.
